fusions.name: Tassel Feint
fusions.desc: A thrust behind a flicked tassel that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds, with a 35% chance to leave it [Blunted] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Colours Aloft
fusions.desc: Sweeps the shaft in a full circle that deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Pitched Pavilion
fusions.desc: Pitches canvas over the grounded shaft where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Pennon Below the Blade
fusions.desc: Conjures a pennon tied below the blade: your critical chance rises by 4%, your critical hits deal 10% more damage, your maximum health rises by 12, and each kill restores 4 health.
